Sub-national coverage target page

Source: R/page-subnational_target.R
subnational_target_ui.Rd

Shows how much of one region meets the coverage targets. One filter chooses an admin level 1 region; the page waits until one is chosen, and the unit counted is always the district. The page is the target charts and table (target_ui()) for that region: by year, the percentage of the region's districts that meet each target group's target (the dataset's get_filtered_threshold()), and a table of the areas of the region whose coverage of a chosen indicator reaches the target (the dataset's get_high_performers()).

Usage

subnational_target_ui(id, i18n)

subnational_target_server(id, cache, i18n, active = reactive(TRUE))

Arguments

id

The module's id. A page's id is also its entry in the app's page registry.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

cache

A reactive that returns the dataset, a CacheConnection.

active

A reactive that is TRUE once the page has been opened with data loaded. The page does no work before that.

Value

subnational_target_ui() returns the page's UI as Shiny tags. subnational_target_server() returns what target_server() returns: a reactive that holds the key of the tab shown.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# the page's entry in an app's page registry
cd_page_def(
  id = "subnational_target",
  ui = subnational_target_ui,
  server = subnational_target_server,
  title = "title_nav_global_coverage",
  section = "title_nav_subnational_analysis",
  subtitle = "sub_target_subnational"
)
} # }
